column1: # KorrinOS language registry — the 55 shipped UI locales.
#   code     language code, used to pick the translation catalogue (msgid domain)
#   locale   FULL locale, used for LANG/LC_ALL. Carries date, number, currency
#            and collation rules, so it is deliberately separate from `code`.
#   endonym  name of the language in that language
#   script   script family, drives terminal font + shaping selection
#   fontpkg  distro font package required for legible rendering in this locale
# Every dir=rtl row must be handled specially by the terminal + UI layers
